title: Compare with earlier exams
summary: See the patient's progress: slider, overlay, changes, map, animation and trends.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide goes on when their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient.

steps.title: Periodontal chart
steps.details: Opens a new periodontal chart: missing teeth, pontics and implants come from the latest odontogram, and the latest closed chart is the guide.

steps.title: Progress
steps.details: Compares today with any earlier exam; by default, with the initial one.

steps.title: First periodontal chart
steps.details: If it is the patient's first one, there is nothing to compare with yet.

steps.title: How to compare
steps.details: Slider (before and after), Overlay (green bars where attachment was gained, red where lost) or Changes; arch; curves or map.

steps.title: Comparison
steps.details: Drag the slider handle to show the patient the before and after.

steps.title: Play the progress
steps.details: Moves from one exam to the next to tell the story of the treatment.

steps.title: Compare today with…
steps.details: Tap another exam to change what today is compared with.

steps.title: Trends
steps.details: Each index across all sessions: green when it improves, red when it gets worse.

steps.title: Worse and better
steps.details: Only changes of 2 mm or more: 1 mm is within the error of a manual probe. Tap a site to see it.
